verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party pricing documentation showing predictable or capped costs as records and queries grow. Community reports point the other way: a per-search pricing model called costly for live-search UIs, large indexes described as too expensive at scale, and sort replicas multiplying record counts (30K to 150K) past plan limits. With no vendor claim of predictable pricing to contradict, this is 'none' rather than 'disputed'.
